about_the_game:
We are planning a Steam Playtest. Unlocking works via the Steam Wishlist. If you are interested in testing the game, please let us know via the Wishlist.

This fast-paced roguelite RPG combines strategic inventory management with intense combat in a dynamic blend of action and planning.

Personalize your adventure with a wide variety of upgradeable and customizable weapons and items, along with powerful synergies that let your characters grow and evolve.

With varied difficulty options, deep meta-progression, and endless replayability, every choice determines your path to victory.

Explore a vast collection of 270 unique items that you can upgrade and enhance. Choose from 60 different weapons, each with its own upgrade path.

Master one of 4 distinct classes - from mighty Knights to powerful Mages- and combine your chosen class with powerful items to create the perfect build for your run.

After each round, seek out one of three unique merchants: visit the mystical Mage for powerful potions and mystical Items, trade valuable goods with the shrewd Trader, or enhance your gear at the Blacksmith's forge. Store excess treasures in your chest, allowing you to build an ever-growing collection of powerful gear.

Your weapons grow stronger with each use, offering a diverse array of enhancements - from temporary boosts to permanent upgrades - allowing you to customize your arsenal as you see fit. 

Discover rare items and experiment with powerful combinations and a system to extract an ability and apply it to another item to optimize your build. Beware—every decision comes at a cost.

Battle your way through relentless hordes of enemies on 27 Hand Crafted Maps and face fearsome boss encounters, including the dreaded Skeleton King, while discovering valuable treasures along your journey.

Each Run features 10 to 16 rounds, with the option of an endless mode. They last around 30 - 60 min. The higher the difficulty level, the longer and harder, but the more you will be rewarded at the end.

Each System is designed in a way to minimize Randomness and prioritize Player Choice, influenced by the inventory and your playstyle.

The longer you survive, the more challenging each round becomes. Every enemy type has unique strengths and weaknesses, including elite versions of each. Stay vigilant—legends speak of colossal ancient titans wandering the vast desert.

Once you complete a run you will return to the HUB, an Oasis located at the top of a mountain to strengthen yourself for the next battle.Crush the Competition in thrilling asynchronous multiplayer battles. Compete against other players’ strategies, earn extra XP for your efforts, and rise through the ranks.

Want a more relaxed experience? You can easily turn off multiplayer mode and focus on your journey at your own pace. The choice is yours—will you dominate the competition or carve your own path?

content_descriptors.notes:
Each enemy has a simple animation when defeated.
When the player character is hit, blood will appear under the character as feedback for the player. The player character has a simple ragdoll animation when it dies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 7700 @ 3.6Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 760 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Fight your way through endless hordes of monsters in this survival roguelite. Craft and optimize your gear, manage your inventory, and use merchant abilities to face increasingly challenging enemies. How long can you survive?
